title: Commit title without a Git section: fall back to 'ID: title', and check it before the run starts

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S31 (2026-10-26): after the owner approved S78, ork ran the finish step and then paused at commit with 'the slice's Git section: the Git section is empty' (internal/engine/states.go:535-547, title.go:27). Almost no slice in this roadmap fills its Git section, so every ork run would stop at the last step after a day of work. The outer session filled S78's Git section by hand in the worktree so the owner could retry.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/states.go:520-547`
- `internal/engine/title.go`
- `internal/engine/plan.go` (or wherever the run plan is checked before launch)
- `docs/design.md:289`
- `docs/design.md:442`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestCommitTitleFallsBackToIDAndTitle: an empty or missing Git section commits as 'ID: slice title'; TestPlanFlagsMissingCommitTitle (if the owner wants a pre-launch check instead).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Owner decision 2026-10-26 (session a2bf7e0e): (a) an empty or missing Git section commits as 'ID: slice title' from slicer show, matching the hand relays' commit messages. No pre-launch refusal.
1. Tests first: TestCommitTitleFallsBackToIDAndTitle; a retry after a commit pause resumes at commit and does not rerun the finish step.
2. title.go and states.go: the fallback.
3. docs/design.md (:289, :442) and CHANGELOG.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/engine; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
